note: From the Harris County Clerk's official sample ballot and declared write-in list for November 3, 2026. Not shown here because they depend on your precinct or district: County Commissioner (Precincts 2 and 4), Justice of the Peace (Place 2 in Precincts 1-8), U.S. House, State Board of Education, State Senate and State House districts, school district trustee and bond/tax-rate measures, municipal utility district, emergency services district and other special-district races and measures, and city races or measures in cities other than Houston (for example Baytown and League City). There are no countywide propositions, and no District Attorney, Sheriff or Constable races, on the Harris County ballot this year. Incumbent flags come from the County Clerk's list of Harris County elected officials. Names are shown in normal capitalization; the ballot prints them in capitals. Check your official sample ballot for the full list.

measures.title: City of Houston, Charter Amendment Election, Proposition A
measures.summary: Would amend the Houston City Charter to require the Houston Police Department to make enforcement of Class A and Class B misdemeanor marijuana possession its lowest law-enforcement priority, with related reporting requirements. It would also prohibit Houston police officers from requesting or executing "no-knock" search warrants.
measures.yesMeans: The charter would make misdemeanor marijuana possession HPD's lowest enforcement priority, add related reporting, and ban no-knock warrants by Houston police.
measures.noMeans: The charter is not changed; current police enforcement priorities and warrant practices stay as they are.
